task: recover a sparse linear function from noisy Gaussian covariates
dataset: synthetic: 40 N(0,1) features, 4 nonzero coefficients at indices 0,3,7,12; noise N(0, 0.8^2)
split: frozen: seed=11, n_train=120, n_test=80; every node uses this exact split
eval_script: stdlib OLS / ridge / lasso CD / oracle OLS on the frozen split; no numpy

knobs.alpha: ridge default 1; lasso default 0.08; ols and oracle must be 0
